scope: Reader first-image priority on current source; host fixtures are not device or live website validation
reported_source: TruyenQQ; 9-10 seconds after leaving and reopening any chapter
verified_causes: Dart queued a reader image behind both already-running cover requests.
Java held its source-state read lock during the entire cover HTTP response, blocking chapter/image writers for up to the 8-second cover timeout.
Opening a continuous chapter at page zero immediately prefetched previous-chapter metadata and, for short chapters, next-chapter metadata before the visible image settled.
changes: One serial reader-image request may execute alongside two bounded covers; new covers do not precede queued pages.
A cover captures its validated request and original source client/headers under a short source-state lock and performs HTTP outside that lock.
A separate session lease preserves ordering for initialize, install, uninstall, preferences changes, browser apply, cookie/cache clear and user-agent reset.
Adjacent continuous chapter prefetch waits for the current visible image to render successfully before starting.
Automatic downloadAhead starts only after the visible image decodes successfully in continuous and paged manga, once per chapter/generation; text readers keep their automatic flow.

Reader downloadAhead checks generation, library revision, lifecycle, current chapter, closing and fixed session privacy. A backwards-compatible optional scheduler cancellation callback rechecks after async conditions/repository lookup and before enqueue/start. Paused readers may retry after resuming with a rendered page.
preserved_contracts: Original HttpSource.getImage(Page), source-owned page URL/token/memo, identity guards, cookie jar, headers, interceptors and image limits.
Cover privacy/browser/cache epochs and singleflight; cancelled/stale reader generation checks and bounded image/chapter retention.
No direct public HTTP fallback for installed source pages; no schema or public runtime protocol change.

dart_before.observed: The page timed out while two cover fixtures remained pending.

java_before.observed: Real Java8 -Xint host chapter RPC timed out at the 2-second deadline while loopback cover responses remained blocked.

prefetch_before.observed: Opening chapter3 fetched adjacent chapters [4,2] before its blocked first image completed.

download_ahead_before.observed: Baseline ReaderScreen started the next-chapter DownloadQueue executor while its first image was still pending.

coverage: Both continuous and paged modes, policy enabled, no automatic download before visible decode, once-only start after success.
No start after first-image failure, dispose, replacement revision, changed reader generation or incognito.
Pause defers launch; resume with a decoded page enables it.
Device-condition lookup completes after dispose/restore/pause: no enqueue/executor; resume retries cancelled preparation.
Text reader retains automatic downloadAhead without an image requirement.

java_boundaries.runtime: Java8 -Xint, host freshly compiled with javac --release8
java_boundaries.skip_reason: Two optional original Komga APK cases have no supplied fixture environment variable.

checks: Both cover requests stay blocked while chapter and first original-source page each complete before their 2-second deadline.
Exact image bytes, source client/header/cookie use, page-hook isolation and URL identity guard remain valid.
clearCookies waits for both cover response leases; late Set-Cookie cannot resurrect live or reopened private cookie storage.

native_image_pipeline_followup.note: Browser replay identity tests await a real visible ImageStream decode before asserting adjacent chapter prefetch.

reference_comparison.requirements: tinh nang phai co.md source cookie and page retrieval requirements (lines236-238).
reference_comparison.mechanism: Mechanism document sections7.1-7.7: Page.getTrueImageUrl, original HttpSource.getImage/Page, offline-first, source headers and bounded near-page prefetch. Section7.7 explicitly describes proposed tuning, not a measured original prefetch algorithm.
reference_comparison.ui: UI spec section7.1/7.2 and user screenshotIMG_6167 continuous chapter transition, preserving location and metadata.
reference_comparison.native_ios_dispatch_source: packages/tachi_runtime/ios/Classes/TachiRuntimePlugin.m uses DISPATCH_QUEUE_CONCURRENT; no native compiler/runtime acceptance claimed.

unverified_or_remaining: No iPhone/TruyenQQ live timing has been measured; the reported 9-10 seconds may include extension/CDN latency in addition to these reproduced artificial waits.

Accepted durable download jobs keep the existing background queue lifecycle; the reader cancellation callback prevents late preparation from enqueuing/starting new work, without deleting manual or already accepted queue jobs.
Already-running foreground/background source metadata/image operations remain serialized; this patch does not interrupt arbitrary extension operations.
No IPA built, CI dispatched, commit or push performed for these source changes.
